_instructions._help: Fill in your character details below. Fields marked with * are required. Remove any _note fields before uploading. All number fields should be plain numbers (no quotes).
_instructions._download: Download this file, fill it in (or have an AI fill it), then upload it on your character sheet page.
_instructions._ai_prompt: Please fill in this D&D 5e character template for me. Ask me questions about my character concept first, then fill in every field. Use only plain numbers for numeric fields and keep descriptions concise.

features._note: Remove this _note field. Add one object per class feature.

weapons._note: Remove this _note field. Add one object per weapon.

inventory._note: Remove this _note field. Add one object per inventory item.

known._note: Remove this _note field. Add one object per known spell.
